# Journey: build the company stage by stage

Work top to bottom. Each stage ends with an **exit gate**; don't move on until you pass it.

| Stage | Purpose | Exit gate |
|---|---|---|
| [00-idea Idea](./00-idea.md) | Turn a vague idea into a one-page statement of who it is for, what problem it solves and how it earns money. | You can state customer, problem, offer and revenue model in four sentences, and name the three riskiest assumptions. |
| [01-validate Validate](./01-validate.md) | Test demand, market, pricing and economics with real evidence before spending money. | Go / adjust / stop decided against criteria written down before the research or interviews started. |
| [02-foundation Foundation](./02-foundation.md) | Set up the legal entity, banking, tax, data protection, contracts and basic financial controls. | Entity registered, bank account open, required licences and data registrations filed or scheduled, lawyer and accountant engaged. |
| [03-build Build](./03-build.md) | Build the product on a repeatable engineering pipeline (source control, CI/CD, security, observability) with agents doing the routine work. | A deployable product with automated tests, a release pipeline and no secrets in the repo. |
| [04-launch Launch](./04-launch.md) | Brand, website, SEO/GEO, go-to-market, first customers and first partnerships. | First paying customers and a measured acquisition channel with known cost per customer. |
| [05-raise Raise](./05-raise.md) | Research investors, build the deck and data room, run outreach and manage a fundraising process. | A funded round closed, or a documented decision to bootstrap instead. |
| [06-operate Operate](./06-operate.md) | Run the company with Fortune-500 cadences: OKRs, dashboards, board reporting, risk register, recurring research. | Weekly and monthly operating rhythm running without founder heroics; metrics reviewed on a schedule. |
| [07-scale Scale](./07-scale.md) | Add markets, hires, partners and systems without breaking what works. | Repeatable playbooks for hiring, new-market entry and customer onboarding. |
